CustomField.description: Read-only, derived from AF_DiscountAmount__c (the numeric-value discount entry) over the priced lines (AF_PricedLinesSubtotal__c, which excludes the Trade-In Deduction line). Sales Reps enter a discount amount, not a percentage - this displays the equivalent percentage automatically. LFRDN-755: was over Subtotal, which is net of the trade-in, so it overstated the percentage actually applied.
CustomField.label: Discount %
